description: THE ADMINISTRATOR ON THE LAST VALUED SLOT, AND THE TRANSFER THAT NEVER RETURNS. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY dispatching option 10 for an administrator, which is the UPPER half of gate G33: CDEMO-USER-TYPE 'A' arrives in the communication area with CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT already 1, so app/cbl/COMEN01C.cbl:87 takes the ELSE, line 92 receives the map, and the ordered EVALUATE EIBAID at 93-103 takes its FIRST arm, WHEN DFHENTER - gate G30. Lines 117-121 are an empty-bodied test-before PERFORM VARYING descending from LENGTH OF OPTIONI, which is the 2 of OPTIONI PIC X(2) at app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:132; byte two of '10' is '0', a DIGIT and not a space, so the UNTIL ... NOT = SPACES term is satisfied on the very first test and the scan stops at WS-IDX 2 rather than walking down to 1. Line 122 moves both bytes into WS-OPTION-X PIC X(02) JUST RIGHT (line 45), where a two-byte sender already fills the receiver so the right-justification changes nothing. Line 123 INSPECT ... REPLACING ALL ' ' BY '0' finds no space and leaves '10' untouched - and note the direction of that substitution: it turns spaces INTO zeros, so the genuine '0' already sitting in byte two is never touched and there is no double substitution. Line 124 leaves WS-OPTION at 10 and line 125 echoes '10' into OPTIONO, which on this path is asserted by the adapter rather than by a ScreenSend, because a transfer sends no map. THE BOUNDARY IS THE POINT: the three-term guard at 127-129 is false on every term - 10 is numeric, 10 is not ZERO, and 10 > CDEMO-MENU-OPT-COUNT is FALSE because the count is exactly 10 at app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:21 and line 128 is a STRICT greater-than. An exclusive bound would reject the very last option the menu offers, so this case sits precisely on the inclusive edge, and case08 holds the other side of it where 11 is rejected. The ungated filter at 136-137 then decides on its FIRST conjunct alone: 88 CDEMO-USRTYP-USER (app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:28) is false for 'A', so no 'No access - Admin Only option... ' is composed. WHAT MAKES THIS DISTINCT from case05, which chooses this same option 10 as a regular user: there the AND is decided by its SECOND conjunct, CDEMO-MENU-OPT-USRTYPE(10) being 'U' and not 'A'; here it is decided by the first, and the second is never what settles it. Both reach the same silence by different routes, and only the administrator route refuses a translation that required the authorisation column to MATCH the caller's type - because a match test paints a refusal here, on a shipped table whose ten columns all read 'U'. Against case03, which is this same administrator on option 01, the difference is the subscript: 1-based 10 must resolve the TENTH and LAST VALUED entry of CDEMO-MENU-OPT OCCURS 12 (app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy:88), whose CDEMO-MENU-OPT-PGMNAME PIC X(08) at :91 holds COBIL00C at :83. A zero-based drift would dispatch to CORPT00C, the ninth entry, and slots 11 and 12 are present-but-unvalued and lie outside the active count, so the expected target name is what separates a correct table read from either mistake. Line 145 finds the flag still OFF from line 77, line 146 finds COBIL00C's leading five bytes to be 'COBIL' and not 'DUMMY', and lines 147, 148 and 151 set CDEMO-FROM-TRANID to 'CM00', CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to 'COMEN01C' and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT back to 0 before the XCTL at 152-155 transfers WITH the communication area. Lines 149 and 150 are COMMENTED OUT, so CDEMO-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-TYPE cross unchanged; nothing here writes CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, which only the PF3 arm at 97 and the signon default at 173 do. THE FALL-THROUGH TRAP is the decisive assertion: an EXEC CICS XCTL never returns, so lines 157-164 do not execute and neither the MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC at 158 nor the STRING at 159-163 happens. Were they reached, that STRING would send 'This option ' DELIMITED BY SIZE, then CDEMO-MENU-OPT-NAME(10) DELIMITED BY SPACE - which stops at the first space of the thirty-five-byte 'Bill Payment' literal at :82 and yields the one token Bill - then 'is coming soon ...' DELIMITED BY SIZE, composing the byte-exact This option Billis coming soon ... with NO space before is. That image is asserted ABSENT: expectedMessages carries the eighty-byte WS-MESSAGE of line 38 exactly as the SPACES of line 79 left it, the eighty and not the seventy-eight-byte ERRMSGO of app/cpy-bms/COMEN01.CPY:138 that only line 187 narrows it to and only case16 pins, so a translation that fell out of the transfer into the coming-soon block fails on the message and on the colour at once. The block stays preserved dead code, neither wired up nor removed: no PGMNAME in app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy begins with 'DUMMY', so line 146 is always true from the shipped table, and case13 reaches it with a stub table instead. Also pinned: sends is empty and no mapset or map is named, because MAP('COMEN1A') and MAPSET('COMEN01') at 190-191 sit inside SEND-MENU-SCREEN, which a transfer never performs, and naming them would tell the client to paint the screen the program is leaving. For the same reason the twelve OPTN00nO lines are not pinned here and are reported at their UNPAINTED image - every byte low-value X'00' and not a space - because BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS at 236-277 is performed only from SEND-MENU-SCREEN, so on a transfer no statement ever writes them, and line 89's MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COMEN1AO belongs to the first-entry path and does not run here either. That is the same answer case03 gives. The successor travels as a response field with the whole conversation in the payload and no server-side forward and no session state - gates G40 and G37. No DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight appears in this folder at all, because COMEN01C copies no CSSETATY - its sole consumer is app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl - so gate G38 is honoured here through the ENTER/REENTER split rather than through a highlight: this is a REENTER-side case that nonetheless emits no error output. CDEMO-USER-TYPE is trusted exactly as it arrives and is never re-read from USRSEC, re-verified or hashed, because line 150 is commented out and the single X(01) comparison at 137 is the whole authorisation mechanism. Recorded rather than silently reconciled: case03's prose forward-refers to this case as the regular-user reading of option 01, which predates this case's own specification - the administrator on the last valued slot is what is pinned here, the regular-user reading of option 10 is case05's, and a sibling fixture is not edited to tidy a cross-reference. The unit is admin.MainMenuService driven directly, with no MockMvc, no HTTP and no JobLauncher - gate G51; inputs, expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty because COMEN01C declares no SELECT and no FD and issues no file verb; expectedReturnCode is 0 because an online transaction sets none; the clock is pinned to the folder-wide instant so that FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE at line 214 is deterministic even on a path that paints no header. Every value here is STATICALLY DERIVED from the COBOL source, the copybooks and the BMS definitions and was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution - no such runtime exists in this environment, per the eight verified blockers recorded in 0.7.6 of the plan (risk R-A).
